landing_contract.finding: the Qwen compute die has NO forwarded-clock lanes: every relay is clocked by a qfd_clkrx regional root (n_clk_r*, clk_coll, clk_ucie, clk_d2d). LANDING-CONTRACT rules L1-L7 (hop-0 ICG epoch, ring, MCP -setup E -hold D-1, price N+2+E) apply to zero lanes, so dv2f13 carries none. Instead the die relies on ideal (zero-skew) regional roots spanning up to 28 mm (r38 28.3x7.9 mm, r1 2.3x15.8, ucie 1.7x16.3, coll 1.9x12.5; r55 drives 160 relays) and on cross-root hops (e.g. sys_face ck=clk_d2d -> relay r55 -> embed_prov r54) timed as same-clock. Under neighbour-relative clocking (owner 10-16) this needs a DECISION: convert inter-region relay lanes to forwarded-clock half-cycle lanes (qfd_rlyf, inverting ck_o) + landings (GEN/relay RTL/die-STA work, new lane), or build + time the die regional trees with propagated clocks.
